# Enterprise imports in the LiteLLM venv that are NOT guarded by ImportError
# (DESIGN §5.1 check 2). LiteLLM 1.104.0, ghcr.io/berriai/litellm-non_root
# index sha256:37066242e6b8327fdd627682a66a9ae2a599553b4d5a84c905c6d8b9eb35c01e.
#
# Columns (tab-separated): path  function  target  handler  category
#   path      relative to the scan root label (site-packages = /app/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages)
#   function  enclosing Class.function, or <module>
#   target    module the import loads
#   handler   exception names of the innermost try whose body contains the import
#   category  degrade = a broad handler swallows the failure, the feature is just missing
#             error   = the failure surfaces to the caller as an error response
# No line numbers on purpose: they move with every release. Any new, missing or
# changed line fails CI; a human re-judges the impact and updates DOCS
# ("unsupported features") before updating this file.
#
# 13 of these are facts C2. The 14th (litellm.proxy.enterprise) is the in-tree
# symlink to enterprise/; it never resolves in the wheel (maturin exclude), so it
# always falls through to `import enterprise` below it.
